tagline: Chemistry feels lighter with the right tools
brief: Full redesign adapting Muse AI Baseten 60:30:10 emerald palette and animations, with bespoke geometric Erlenmeyer Flask & Reaction brand mark.

concepts.name: Glassware & Reaction
concepts.idea: An iconic geometric Erlenmeyer flask with vivid emerald reaction meniscus and rising bubbles.
rationale: Replaces abstract orbits with genuine chemistry laboratory glassware.
Precision 60-degree conical slope creates perfect geometric balance.
Vivid emerald liquid meniscus (#00C853) provides instant visual punch.
Graduated tick marks and rising reaction bubbles denote active computation and transformation.

recommendation: The Flask Reaction mark paired with the Baseten 60:30:10 palette delivers an immediate, energetic chemistry identity that is instantly recognizable on dark and light screens.
